import type { SkipLinkContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class SkipLink extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        links: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        visibility: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    links: SkipLinkContract['links'];
    visibility: string;
    constructor();
    private activate;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
